query: I have an interview with Globex on Thursday for the data analyst job I applied to. Help me prepare.
rationale: Canonical case: a scheduled interview on a tracked application.

query: Prep me for my phone screen tomorrow for the nursing position I applied for
rationale: Recruiter/phone screen stage, non-tech role (generalist family).

query: Run a mock interview for my hiring manager round at Acme
What questions will they ask in my panel interview for the welding supervisor job I applied to?
rationale: Likely-questions request for a behavioral panel, trades role.

query: Help me build STAR stories from my resume for my interview next week for the teaching job
rationale: STAR examples grounded in the submitted resume are this member's core output.

query: I'm the hiring manager. Write interview questions and a scorecard to evaluate candidates for our analyst opening
rationale: Hiring side (interviewer prep), not the candidate. Collision guard against generic HR interview skills.

query: Write a thank-you note to the interviewer from yesterday's phone screen
rationale: Post-interview thank-you drafts belong to application-tracker.

query: Mark the Acme application as interviewing
rationale: Tracker status changes belong to application-tracker; interview-prep never writes tracker.json.

query: Help me negotiate the salary on my offer from Globex
rationale: Salary negotiation is out of scope for this member and the family.

query: Prepare questions for a podcast interview I'm hosting next week
rationale: Media/podcast interviews are not job interviews.

query: Tailor my resume for this product manager role at Stripe
What's a good recipe for banana bread?
rationale: Negative control - unrelated to job hunting.

query: Help me practice answering 'tell me about yourself' for my interview at Acme on Monday
rationale: Answer practice for a scheduled interview (mock-mode territory).

query: I got a second-round interview at the hospital I applied to. What should I ask them?
rationale: Questions to ask is a core part of the prep pack; later-round stage.

query: Explain how to run a structured behavioral interview when I'm the interviewer
rationale: Interviewer technique, hiring side. Collision guard.

query: I'm interviewing contractors to remodel my kitchen. What should I ask them?
rationale: 'Interviewing' outside a job search; negative control for the word alone.
